description: This Java class `DelinquencyRangeParseAndValidator` is responsible for parsing and validating JSON input related to delinquency range data within a Fineract module. It extracts relevant fields from JSON commands, validates them, and constructs a `DelinquencyRangeData` object.

classes.name: DelinquencyRangeParseAndValidator
classes.description: A Spring component class that extends a generic ParseAndValidator, specializing in parsing and validating delinquency range data JSON commands.

methods.name: validateAndParseUpdate
methods.description: Validates and parses a JSON command to produce a DelinquencyRangeData object, throwing validation errors if present.

methods.name: validateAndParseUpdate (private)
methods.description: Performs detailed validation and extraction from a JSON object for delinquency range fields and constructs the data object if valid.
